description: This file defines development routes for a Node.js Express application, including endpoints for database status, data seeding, verification, and seed data for LLM costs. It manages access control for dev-only routes and handles dynamic model loading with fallbacks.

classes.name: Sample
classes.description: Dynamically loaded or stub model for 'sample' collection, with fallback in-memory implementation.

methods.name: Sample.countDocuments
methods.description: Counts documents in the sample collection or in-memory array.

methods.name: Sample.insertMany
methods.description: Inserts multiple documents into the sample collection or in-memory array.

methods.name: Sample.findOne
methods.description: Finds the most recent sample document or returns null.

methods.name: Sample.find
methods.description: Retrieves a limited set of sample documents or from in-memory array.
